limits: GitHub Actions native processes qualify the stated macOS ARM64 Apple Clang/Rust profiles; they are not physical-device or hardware fault-recovery evidence.

Only Visual Studio environment setup is skipped in the two macOS jobs. Existing POSIX/Darwin process-boundary tests ran; this does not establish all scheduler interleavings or a general memory-model theorem.
C++ consumer and native ABI/STB targets use Rust backend. Rust compiler internal LLVM version is not the project HIA LLVM backend. No HIA LLVM AOT macOS qualification is implied.
STB HIA native_requested and native_executed are false in both variants. The 696 HIA observations are interpreted, and their allocator counters are not native observations.
Native ABI Rust compiler argv/raw streams and temporary Rust input bytes are not retained by that original qualifier; its structured receipt, canonical input and object hashes are retained.

Each C++ upstream version reports two process-lifetime registry allocations retained with ordinary object live delta zero. These are not zero retained allocations and are separate from the P2 owner/library registry scope.

Finite library/ABI/cancellation/lifetime cases do not establish general source equivalence, all interleavings, foreign lifetime soundness, development cost improvement or all upstream configuration support.
